network_WiFi_RoamFT: do appropriate cleanup at the end of test_body Many tests were failing because of https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromiumos/third_party/autotest/+/1341181. When the test reran, it would deauth the associated DUT, which would blacklist the AP. This would cause association problems on the second run. Disconnect from the network at the end of test_body so that this doesn't happen. BUG=None TEST=Ran on caroline at my desk. Also ran on chromeos15-row2-rack11-host4 which was previously failing the test.
